registered_chat_goal: Act as the main responsible worker for AI-Statistician: take the hard central AgentRuntime and evaluation work, proactively coordinate other Codex/GitHub branches, preserve strict evidence boundaries, and keep driving the repo toward a live autonomous AI Statistical Theory Lab rather than side audits or easy patches.
current_goal_focus: Make long-horizon theory and independent mathematical review genuinely document-native before frontier claims. TheoryDeveloper and its referee author Markdown/LaTeX; JSON carries only content-addressed references, ordered statuses, claim dependencies, findings, and consumer ABIs. Preserve model ownership of mathematics, keep formalization task-optional, freeze confirmatory evidence, delete legacy expanded review transport before adding orchestration, and validate shared mechanisms only on future disjoint benchmarks without resampling any failed draw.
operating_principle: Models own statistical, mathematical, Python, R, retrieval-query, and Lean content. The harness owns isolation, immutable identity, source visibility, budgets, checkpoints, independent review, result blinding, frozen evaluation authority, and proof promotion. It does not author substantive fixes.
canonical_research_graph: freeze task intent, source visibility, and per-dimension evidence requirements
scout literature, repositories, code, and data when permitted; rerun exact public artifacts before reimplementation
maintain a persistent theory workspace with assumptions, equations, claim dependencies, counterchecks, and explicit gaps
start exploratory Python or R once consumed theory interfaces are stable enough; return non-confirmatory observations to TheoryDeveloper
independently review a stable theory and source checkpoint before freezing confirmatory metrics and simulation precision
run a light formal scout in parallel when useful; run deep Lean work after statement stability unless task intent is proof_first
report independent theory, replication, scientific-code, empirical, formal, novelty, and unresolved-gap evidence
canonical_workspace_loop: the source-owning model reads the exact current artifact and raw observation

the model chooses retrieval, inspection, hash-bound localized document editing, complete source or artifact replacement, exact current-source execution in a changed dependency environment, or an explicit gap
the local Python, R, simulation, or Lean environment executes the exact model-authored artifact unchanged
the raw observation returns to the same model until pass, explicit gap, or bounded exhaustion

kept: content-addressed artifact references and immutable parent hashes
fresh confirmatory cohorts and pre-outcome gate freezing
forbidden: task-family answers, thresholds, aliases, Lean grammar, or tactic rules
routine Architect routing inside a source workspace
simulation, retrieval, or model judgment promoted to theorem proof
